name: Book Visibility
description: Adds block-visibility conditions based on the current book (show/hide blocks per book). Controls block visibility, not book access.
project_description:
This module enhances the book module by creating a per book block visibility configuration.

 It uses a plugin which extends ConditionPluginBase to add a new "Book" tab on the block configuration page .

 Use contrib book module instead 
 The functionality covered by the book_visibility module is included with the contrib book module. The core book module has been deprecated in Drupal 10.3. Only use this module if you are on an older core version.
